lines: This plan covers 3 days, starting Wednesday 2026-08-19.
A session is set for Wednesday: you cook on Monday and Friday, and nothing cooked then can feed the days before it. It is a day you did not ask for.
One meal is skipped, you marked it away from home.
To stay inside it, expensive proteins give first, then out-of-season produce, then variety — never the portions.

dishes.name: Paprika mushroom egg mug
dishes.title: Eggs, mushrooms, cottage cheese and toast
dishes.method: Put the mushrooms in a large microwave-safe mug or bowl and microwave for 3 minutes. Drain any liquid, stir in the eggs and smoked paprika, then microwave in short bursts until set. Add the cottage cheese and serve with toast.
dishes.why: This large, warm breakfast is quick before a sitting-heavy day, with mushrooms as the loud vegetable.

dishes.name: Cool courgette cottage crunch
dishes.title: Cottage cheese, courgette ribbons and oatcakes
dishes.method: Pile the courgette ribbons beside the cottage cheese, season, add the measured olive oil and eat with the oatcakes.
dishes.why: It is a small, crisp lunch that needs no cooking before the added Wednesday kitchen session.

dishes.name: Crackling paprika tofu tray
dishes.title: Paprika-crusted tofu, potato wedges, courgettes and mushrooms
dishes.method: During the added Wednesday cooking session, bake all three preparations together. Plate one serving of each while hot and spoon over the yoghurt; cool and refrigerate the remaining portions promptly.
dishes.why: The smoky crust answers this week's craving while the hot tray provides a proper dinner without using a hob.

dishes.name: Savoury yoghurt oat bowl
dishes.title: Greek yoghurt, oats, courgette and walnuts
dishes.method: Stir the oats, grated courgette and chives into the yoghurt, season with pepper and scatter over the walnuts.
dishes.why: This substantial breakfast assembles quickly and keeps the crisp courgette unmistakable on the plate.

dishes.name: Smoky tofu ribbon wrap
dishes.title: Paprika tofu, roasted courgettes and mushrooms in a wrap

ingredients.term: plain wholemeal wrap without added sweetener

dishes.method: Lay one cold serving of tofu and one serving of roasted vegetables across the wrap, add the yoghurt and roll tightly.
dishes.why: The small lunch travels cleanly for a driving week and makes Wednesday's tofu feel like a different meal.

dishes.name: Hot tofu toast stack
dishes.title: Warm tofu, courgettes, mushrooms and cottage cheese on toast
dishes.method: Reheat the tofu, roasted vegetables and potato wedges in the microwave until piping hot. Toast the bread, pile on the tofu and vegetables, add the cottage cheese and serve the wedges alongside.
dishes.why: A warm, smoky toast stack avoids a plain cold dinner and uses the batch in a visibly different form.

dishes.name: Golden mushroom breakfast bake
dishes.title: Paprika egg bake, yoghurt and toast
dishes.method: Make the egg bake in Friday's morning cooking session. Eat one hot serving with the yoghurt and toast, then cool and refrigerate the second serving promptly for lunch.
dishes.why: Cooking this before the night run protects Friday evening while still giving breakfast a crisp paprika top.

dishes.name: Paprika bake lunch box
dishes.title: Egg, cottage cheese, mushrooms, courgette and oatcakes
dishes.method: Pack the chilled second serving of egg bake with the oatcakes. Eat it cold or reheat it at the depot if a microwave is available.
dishes.why: This compact lunch is ready before the night shift and leaves Friday dinner correctly unplanned.

preparations.title: Paprika-crusted tofu
preparations.method: Toss the torn tofu with the cornflour, smoked paprika, oil, salt and pepper. Spread it on one section of a large lined oven tray and roast at 230°C until browned with crisp edges.

preparations.title: Roasted courgettes and mushrooms
preparations.method: Toss the courgettes and mushrooms with the smoked paprika, oil, salt and pepper. Spread them beside the tofu and roast at 230°C, turning once if convenient.

preparations.title: Smoked paprika potato wedges
preparations.method: Microwave the wedges in a covered microwave-safe bowl for 5 minutes. Toss with smoked paprika, oil, salt and pepper, then spread on the hot tray and roast until crusted.

preparations.title: Crusted paprika egg and mushroom bake

ingredients.term: plain oatcakes without added sweetener, crushed

preparations.method: Heat the oven to 230°C. Mix the eggs, cottage cheese, mushrooms, courgette, smoked paprika, salt and pepper in a small lined baking dish. Mix the crushed oatcakes with the oil, scatter them over the top and bake until set with a golden crust.

cooking_sessions.run_through: Heat the oven to 230°C and put a large lined tray inside. Cut the potatoes first and microwave them for 5 minutes. While they soften, tear and coat the tofu, then cut and season the courgettes and mushrooms. Add everything to separate sections of the hot tray and roast for about 15 minutes. Plate dinner, then cool and refrigerate the Thursday portions promptly.

Before the night run, heat the oven to 230°C. Slice the mushrooms and grate the courgette while it heats, mix the egg-bake base directly in its lined dish, then crush and oil the oatcake topping. Bake until set, eat one serving for breakfast and cool the lunch serving promptly.

shopping_list.term: plain wholemeal wrap without added sweetener
